buildings.name: Drain
buildings.description: 9 out of 10 plumbers recommend Drain® for its uncloggability. Our new Drain® companion product, Clog-Be-Gone™, will hit shelves soon. Now less likely to vaporize unexpectedly during normal operation!
buildings.effect: Slowly drains liquids into a pipe.
buildings.notes: Option-dependent (PLib options, defaults used here): UseSolidDrain=false selects drain_kanim / non-solid tile; true selects solidDrain_kanim, isSolidTile=true, and samples the cell above. FlowRate (default 0.1 kg/s, range 0.1-1.0) sets ElementConsumer.consumptionRate. Foundation tile that passively drinks the liquid in its cell into a liquid pipe.
